column3: With respect to the ONX Industrial Campus Mortgage Loan (3.2%), a subtenant, NYCanna (the “Subtenant”), occupying approximately 17.3% of the net rentable area at the related Mortgaged Property, operates its space to cultivate, warehouse and distribute marijuana. Although permitted under applicable state law, the possession and sale of marijuana remains illegal under applicable federal law. An affiliate of the borrowers is the sublandlord under a master lease, representing approximately 8.9% of the underwritten rent, at the related Mortgaged Property.
